title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-sj6v: allow_no_piv_response guard blocks PIV-included responses
description:
In protect_response() at lib.rs:949, the guard `if !self.allow_no_piv_response { return Err(OscoreError::InvalidParam); }` is placed before the include_piv branch, blocking ALL protect_response calls on restored contexts even when include_piv=true. RFC 8613 Section 5.2 allows responders to include their own PIV in responses regardless of the no-PIV-response policy. The guard should be: `if !include_piv && !self.allow_no_piv_response { ... }`.

Additionally, lines 975-977 perform a redundant PIV length check after OscoreSeqNum::from_piv() already succeeded at line 970 (from_piv rejects empty and oversized PIVs). This dead code should be removed.
